Ok so I bought this after my old one died and honestly im torn. The good: it heats up FAST, like way faster than i expected, and the carafe doesnt drip everywhere when you pour which was my #1 complaint with the last brand. Looks nice on the counter too, my wife actually commented on it lol.

But. The lid. Whoever designed the lid needs to rethink their life choices. you have to push it down at this weird angle or it wont click and then it beeps at you forever. took me like 4 days to figure out the trick. also the "medium" setting is basically just hot water imo, i run everything on dark now.

Would i buy again? probably yeah. its been 3 months no issues other than the lid thing. just wish it came with better instructions, the little booklet is mostly warnings in 9 languages and barely tells you anything useful. 4 stars, would be 5 if the lid wasnt so dumb.
